# GulfRakza

> GulfRakza is the trading name of Rakzah Gulf Trading Establishment, an industrial supplier and engineering-services provider headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

- English: https://www.gulfrakza.com/en

- Sitemap: https://www.gulfrakza.com/sitemap.xml

## Business facts

- Legal name: Rakzah Gulf Trading Establishment
- Location: Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
- Service area: Saudi Arabia, with primary coverage in the Eastern Province
- Products: industrial supplies, PPE, safety equipment, lifting equipment, welding supplies, and marine supplies
- Services: integrated engineering and industrial support services
- Email: info@gulfrakza.com
